{{Quote|Now I think our guardian could use a little help from ''his'' friends! In the form of that ''packing net!''|Vik Idd|<ref name="Droids (1986) 2">[[Droids (1986) 2|''Droids'' (1986) 2]]</ref>}}
A '''packing net''' was a kind of [[Net/Legends|net]] that could be dropped on and ensnare people. [[Vik Idd]] dropped one on members of the [[Fromm Gang/Legends|Fromm Gang]] aboard [[Lonn Idd's repair station]] at some point between [[19 BBY/Legends|19]] and [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]].
